brief:
The Organisation of Islamic Cooperation condemned Israeli attacks on Palestinians in Gaza and the occupied West Bank during a meeting of foreign ministers held Thursday in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, Middle East Eye reported. The 57-member bloc issued the statement as a collective response to ongoing military operations across Palestinian territories.

The foreign ministers gathered to address escalating violence affecting Palestinian civilians and infrastructure. The OIC, which represents Muslim-majority nations and organizations worldwide, has repeatedly issued statements on the Israeli-Palestinian conflict. The Jeddah meeting underscored coordinated diplomatic efforts among member states to respond to the situation in Gaza and the West Bank.
